use: Surface and night-lights textures for the orbit simulator's Earth (/orbit and the home page).
relationship: External Earth imagery. Does not depict Satellite Inference hardware, and NASA does not endorse Satellite Inference.

assets.collection: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation, September 2004, with topography and bathymetry
assets.modifications: Resized to 1024 x 512 (Lanczos) and WebP compression, quality 74. Equirectangular projection unchanged.

assets.collection: NASA Black Marble 2016, Earth at Night, 0.1 degree global composite
assets.source: NASA Earth Observatory / NASA Goddard Space Flight Center (Suomi NPP VIIRS)
assets.modifications: Resized to 1024 x 512 (Lanczos), converted to grayscale and WebP compression, quality 70. The simulator keeps only the brightest lights and tints them.

rendering: The simulator lights the surface with the modeled Sun direction and adds an atmospheric rim. Clouds and seasonal snow are not modeled.
attribution: Earth imagery: NASA Blue Marble Next Generation and NASA Black Marble 2016, NASA Earth Observatory.
